column1: # 欽定詞譜 (1715), one row per 格 (metrical pattern) of one 詞牌 (tune title).
# THE TRADITION'S OWN SPEC. Doctrine 62: the primary source states the rule you
# were about to invent, and here it states the one thing a text can never
# supply -- WHICH line ends the tune mandates as rhymes and which it does not.
# Without it a ci rhyme measurement has to infer its own ground truth from the
# characters it is scoring, which is doctrine 13's circularity in one step.
# SOURCE  hulbji/couyun, MIT (LICENSE at repo root, covers the repository),
#         from the 欽定詞譜. Reached by `git clone https://github.com/hulbji/
#         couyun` (data/CHANNELS.md). The 欽定詞譜 itself is a 1715 imperial
#         compilation: a millennium-adjacent work three centuries out of any
#         term (doctrine 40, the outer layer is MIT and the inner layer is
#   tune      the 詞牌, in traditional characters
#   aliases   other names the 詞譜 gives the same tune, '|' separated
#   chars     total characters in the 格
#   groups    the rhyme groups: positions '.' separated within a group, groups
#             '/' separated. Positions are 0-based indices into the poem's
#             character sequence with all punctuation stripped. TWO POSITIONS
#             RHYME IFF THEY ARE IN THE SAME GROUP.
#   ju        line ends the spec marks 句 -- it mandates NO rhyme there. This
#             column is what makes a matched control possible at all.
#   du        讀 positions: a phrase break INSIDE a line, not a line end.
#   template  the 平仄 template, 中 where the tune leaves the tone free.
# HOW groups WAS BUILT, and why not from the source's own `yun_classify`.
# `yun_classify` is not a spec statement: on 菩薩蠻 格三 it places positions
# 6/13 in the same group as 18/23, and 菩薩蠻 changes rhyme between them --
# 雪 does not rhyme 眉. The groups here are read from what the notation prints:
# a new group at every 换 marker, and at every change in the register the
# template mandates at consecutive rhyme positions. That declines to assert a
# 平仄通叶 relation anywhere, which is the conservative direction: it can only
# split a real group, never merge two.
# THE MARKER GRAMMAR IS LOCALLY AMBIGUOUS and the parse is constrained, not
# guessed. 平 and 仄 are both template symbols and rhyme-marker prefixes
# (平韵, 仄韵, 换平韵, 换仄韵), so `中仄中平仄韵` is five template positions plus
# 韵 or four plus 仄韵. The parse is a search required to satisfy the source's
# own two invariants at once -- the template length must equal `ge_lyu_str`
# and the 韻 positions must equal `rhyme_pos`. 8 of 2,294 格 admit no such
# parse and are REFUSED rather than resolved by a tie-break (doctrine 66).
# Reading every 平/仄 as template instead -- the obvious first pass -- drops
# every 換韻 tune including 菩薩蠻's canonical 格, and drops them SILENTLY,
# because a mis-parse fails the invariant and looks like an unparsable file.
